verdict.rationale: Poly stores users' own files rather than a proprietary format, and journal entries are plain Markdown files (poly-docs-12). Its own tools can move everything to local disk: the desktop app exposes files as a real folder, and pinning a folder downloads everything inside it (poly-docs-23, poly-docs-47); the CLI `cp` command copies from Poly to local disk (poly-docs-42). However, no dedicated full-account export is documented, and there is no evidence that AI-derived data such as Mind memories, indexes or tags can leave in open formats. Missing for 10: a documented one-click/bulk export feature, export of Mind memories and metadata in open formats, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.
